svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.16.2.1 Required Installation of Granular Material
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.16.2.1 Required Installation of Granular Material
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.16 FLOORS-ON-GROUND
Required Installation of Granular Material

g.text: Coarse clean granular material, not more
Garage, carport or accessory building slab:

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Sentence (2), not less than 100
mm (3 15/16″) of coarse clean granular
material containing not more than 10% of
material that will pass a 4 mm sieve is placed
beneath floors-on-ground
See Note A-9.16.2.1.(1), Subsection 9.13.4. and
Note A-9.13.4. The drainage layer is also
gas-permeable and conforms to Article 9.13.4.3.
in buildings to which that Article applies.
Granular material need not be installed under
(a) slabs in garages, carports or accessory
buildings, or (b) buildings of industrial
occupancy where the process permits or requires
large openings in the building envelope even
during the winter.
Drawn: A a basement edge, B a garage slab. Sizes other than the limit are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.16.2.1. (page 9-129), with Note A-9.16.2.1.(1)
